notes.title: The Birnchen Group at Gamescom 2023
notes.content:
We were there at this year's Gamescom from August 23-27 to present the first adventure of our Birnchen & Friends series, "Birnchen & Friends: Minor Confrontations", to a great community.

In their first real-time strategy game, Birnchen and Mr. Blue compete against each other in a colorful children's room to fight each other with lots of imagination and fun to get the victory for a bowl of candy. The game is suitable for children aged six and up, but of course it's fun for the grown-ups too! That's why we were even happier to have met lots of new faces at Gamescom, playing and reviewing our game for the first time. Thanks to all of you for being there and helping us improve "Birnchen & Friends: Minor Confrontations" with your feedback. We take all comments to heart and try to implement them as best we can.

At gamescom, however, it wasn't just virtually that some fruit was shipped. We distributed a total of 70 melons to the eager first-time visitors of our community. All fans who tested our RTS also received a keychain, so we were able to give away a total of 500 tags to you. Thanks to your active support, we also found five new bugs that caused various display errors. These and other bugs will be fixed by us in five phases starting from September 18.
